message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that caught me off guard. At first, I was scrambling around for flashlights and power banks, but then I decided to embrace the moment. I grabbed a few blankets, set up a little cozy corner with my husband, and we made it a special evening of stargazing through the window while charging our phones. It turned out to be a lovely way to connect without our usual distractions! Have you ever turned an unexpected situation into a cozy night in?
